home_welcome_body: This app shows the Colaxy packages working together: adaptive navigation, theming, localization, onboarding and persisted preferences.
home_package_adaptive_scaffold: colaxy_adaptive_scaffold — the navigation shell you're looking at
home_package_theme_picker: app_theme_picker — the colors and light/dark mode, in Settings
home_package_tutorial: colaxy_tutorial — the intro you saw on first launch
home_package_riverpod_helper: riverpod_helper — the persisted counter on the Favorites tab
home_package_info_tile: app_info_tile — the About entry, in Settings
favorites_body: Stored with riverpod_helper's SharedPreferences-backed provider — close and reopen the app and it's still here.
intro_page1_body: Resize the window: this app switches between a bottom bar and a side rail automatically.
intro_page2_body: Theming, language, onboarding and preferences are all provided by packages in this workspace. Check Settings to try them.
